description: This file configures the Django admin interface for a recipe management application, registering models, defining admin classes, and custom actions.

classes.name: CustomUserAdmin
classes.description: Custom admin class for User model, disables add permission.

classes.name: SpaceAdmin
classes.description: Admin configuration for Space model with custom delete action.

classes.name: UserPreferenceAdmin
classes.description: Admin for UserPreference with custom display name.

classes.name: SearchPreferenceAdmin
classes.description: Admin for SearchPreference with custom display name.

classes.name: SupermarketAdmin
classes.description: Admin for Supermarket with inline categories.

classes.name: KeywordAdmin
classes.description: TreeAdmin for Keyword with sorting actions.

classes.name: StepAdmin
classes.description: Admin for Step with orphan deletion action.

classes.name: RecipeAdmin
classes.description: Admin for Recipe with index rebuilding action.

classes.name: IngredientAdmin
classes.description: Admin for Ingredient with orphan deletion.

classes.name: PropertyTypeAdmin
classes.description: Admin for PropertyType with delete action.

methods.name: has_add_permission
methods.description: Overrides permission to prevent adding new User instances.

methods.name: delete_space_action
methods.description: Custom admin action to delete spaces.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Static method to display user name in preferences.

methods.name: created_by
methods.description: Method to display creator's name for recipes and meal plans.

methods.name: user_name
methods.description: Method to display creator's name for recipe books.

methods.name: recipe_and_name
methods.description: Displays recipe name and step name, or orphaned message.

methods.name: rebuild_index
methods.description: Rebuilds search index for recipes and steps.

methods.name: delete_unattached_steps
methods.description: Deletes steps not linked to any recipe.

methods.name: delete_unattached_ingredients
methods.description: Deletes ingredients not linked to any recipe.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Displays user display name for comments.
